hooks.command: jq -c 'if (.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("\\.py$") then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:"Python (.py) file edit detected. If not already done this turn, invoke Skill(skill=\"python-coding-style\") to apply Ruff config, immutability, naming, type hints, file/function size limits."}} else empty end'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"PLAN APPROVED via Plannotator. This PostToolUse:ExitPlanMode hook fires only on Approve (annotation/edit requests deny the tool and never reach here, so reaching this point means the plan was approved). MANDATORY -- do NOT implement inline in this planning session: (1) Promote the approved plan into docs/plans/ of the CURRENT project (cwd). Plannotator saved the approved plan under ~/.claude/plans/ as the most recently modified .md file; identify it by matching its content to the plan you just submitted, then copy that file (preserving its frontmatter) into docs/plans/ using its frontmatter intended_final_path as the destination, otherwise the convention docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-short-slug.md. Create docs/plans/ if missing, and update intended_final_path so it matches the actual saved path. (2) If this project has no docs/plans/ convention, or you cannot confidently identify the approved plan file, do NOT guess -- skip the copy and just report where the plan was saved. (3) Then tell the user to run /clear and, in a fresh session, run /ce-work <docs/plans path> to execute (Build phase -- suggest switching to /model sonnet and /effort high). Inline implementation in this planning session is forbidden."}}'
